versos.hebraico: וַיְהִי֙ כִּֽי־זָקֵ֣ן יִצְחָ֔ק וַתִּכְהֶ֥יןָ עֵינָ֖יו מֵרְאֹ֑ת וַיִּקְרָ֞א אֶת־עֵשָׂ֣ו׀ בְּנ֣וֹ הַגָּדֹ֗ל וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֵלָיו֙ בְּנִ֔י וַיֹּ֥אמֶר אֵלָ֖יו הִנֵּֽנִי׃

controles.web: When Isaac was old, and his eyes were dim, so that he could not see, he called Esau his elder son, and said to him, “My son?”   He said to him, “Here I am.”
controles.kjv: And it came to pass, that when Isaac was old, and his eyes were dim, so that he could not see, he called Esau his eldest son, and said unto him, My son: and he said unto him, Behold, here am I.
controles.livre: E aconteceu que quando havia Isaque envelhecido, e seus olhos se ofuscaram ficando sem vista, chamou a Esaú, seu filho o maior, e disse-lhe: Meu filho. E ele respondeu: Eis-me aqui.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֕אמֶר הִנֵּה־נָ֖א זָקַ֑נְתִּי לֹ֥א יָדַ֖עְתִּי י֥וֹם מוֹתִֽי׃

controles.web: He said, “See now, I am old. I don’t know the day of my death.
controles.kjv: And he said, Behold now, I am old, I know not the day of my death:
controles.livre: E ele disse: Eis que já sou velho, não sei o dia de minha morte:

versos.hebraico: וְעַתָּה֙ שָׂא־נָ֣א כֵלֶ֔יךָ תֶּלְיְךָ֖ וְקַשְׁתֶּ֑ךָ וְצֵא֙ הַשָּׂדֶ֔ה וְצ֥וּדָה לִּ֖י צידה׃

controles.web: Now therefore, please take your weapons, your quiver and your bow, and go out to the field, and take me venison.
controles.kjv: Now therefore take, I pray thee, thy weapons, thy quiver and thy bow, and go out to the field, and take me some venison;
controles.livre: Toma, pois, agora tuas armas, tua aljava e teu arco, e sai ao campo, e pega-me caça;

versos.hebraico: וַעֲשֵׂה־לִ֨י מַטְעַמִּ֜ים כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר אָהַ֛בְתִּי וְהָבִ֥יאָה לִּ֖י וְאֹכֵ֑לָה בַּעֲב֛וּר תְּבָרֶכְךָ֥ נַפְשִׁ֖י בְּטֶ֥רֶם אָמֽוּת׃

controles.web: Make me savory food, such as I love, and bring it to me, that I may eat, and that my soul may bless you before I die.”
controles.kjv: And make me savoury meat, such as I love, and bring it to me, that I may eat; that my soul may bless thee before I die.
controles.livre: E faze-me um guisado, como eu gosto, e traze-o a mim, e comerei: para que te abençoe minha alma antes que morra.

versos.hebraico: וְרִבְקָ֣ה שֹׁמַ֔עַת בְּדַבֵּ֣ר יִצְחָ֔ק אֶל־עֵשָׂ֖ו בְּנ֑וֹ וַיֵּ֤לֶךְ עֵשָׂו֙ הַשָּׂדֶ֔ה לָצ֥וּד צַ֖יִד לְהָבִֽיא׃

controles.web: Rebekah heard when Isaac spoke to Esau his son. Esau went to the field to hunt for venison, and to bring it.
controles.kjv: And Rebekah heard when Isaac spake to Esau his son. And Esau went to the field to hunt for venison, and to bring it.
controles.livre: E Rebeca estava ouvindo, quando falava Isaque a Esaú seu filho: e foi-se Esaú ao campo para pegar a caça que havia de trazer.

versos.hebraico: וְרִבְקָה֙ אָֽמְרָ֔ה אֶל־יַעֲקֹ֥ב בְּנָ֖הּ לֵאמֹ֑ר הִנֵּ֤ה שָׁמַ֨עְתִּי֙ אֶת־אָבִ֔יךָ מְדַבֵּ֛ר אֶל־עֵשָׂ֥ו אָחִ֖יךָ לֵאמֹֽר׃

controles.web: Rebekah spoke to Jacob her son, saying, “Behold, I heard your father speak to Esau your brother, saying,
controles.kjv: And Rebekah spake unto Jacob her son, saying, Behold, I heard thy father speak unto Esau thy brother, saying,
controles.livre: Então Rebeca falou a Jacó seu filho, dizendo: Eis que eu ouvi a teu pai que falava com Esaú teu irmão, dizendo:

versos.hebraico: הָבִ֨יאָה לִּ֥י צַ֛יִד וַעֲשֵׂה־לִ֥י מַטְעַמִּ֖ים וְאֹכֵ֑לָה וַאֲבָרֶכְכָ֛ה לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה לִפְנֵ֥י מוֹתִֽי׃

controles.web: ‘Bring me venison, and make me savory food, that I may eat, and bless you before Yahweh before my death.’
controles.kjv: Bring me venison, and make me savoury meat, that I may eat, and bless thee before the Lord before my death.
controles.livre: Traze-me caça, e faze-me um guisado, para que coma, e te abençoe diante do SENHOR antes que eu morra.

versos.hebraico: וְעַתָּ֥ה בְנִ֖י שְׁמַ֣ע בְּקֹלִ֑י לַאֲשֶׁ֥ר אֲנִ֖י מְצַוָּ֥ה אֹתָֽךְ׃

controles.web: Now therefore, my son, obey my voice according to that which I command you.
controles.kjv: Now therefore, my son, obey my voice according to that which I command thee.
controles.livre: Agora, pois, filho meu, obedece à minha voz no que te mando;

versos.hebraico: לֶךְ־נָא֙ אֶל־הַצֹּ֔אן וְקַֽח־לִ֣י מִשָּׁ֗ם שְׁנֵ֛י גְּדָיֵ֥י עִזִּ֖ים טֹבִ֑ים וְאֶֽעֱשֶׂ֨ה אֹתָ֧ם מַטְעַמִּ֛ים לְאָבִ֖יךָ כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר אָהֵֽב׃

controles.web: Go now to the flock, and get me from there two good young goats. I will make them savory food for your father, such as he loves.
controles.kjv: Go now to the flock, and fetch me from thence two good kids of the goats; and I will make them savoury meat for thy father, such as he loveth:
controles.livre: Vai agora ao gado, e traze-me dali dois bons cabritos das cabras, e farei deles iguarias para teu pai, como ele gosta;

versos.hebraico: וְהֵבֵאתָ֥ לְאָבִ֖יךָ וְאָכָ֑ל בַּעֲבֻ֛ר אֲשֶׁ֥ר יְבָרֶכְךָ֖ לִפְנֵ֥י מוֹתֽוֹ׃

controles.web: You shall bring it to your father, that he may eat, so that he may bless you before his death.”
controles.kjv: And thou shalt bring it to thy father, that he may eat, and that he may bless thee before his death.
controles.livre: E tu as levarás a teu pai, e comerá, para que te abençoe antes de sua morte.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר יַעֲקֹ֔ב אֶל־רִבְקָ֖ה אִמּ֑וֹ הֵ֣ן עֵשָׂ֤ו אָחִי֙ אִ֣ישׁ שָׂעִ֔ר וְאָנֹכִ֖י אִ֥ישׁ חָלָֽק׃

controles.web: Jacob said to Rebekah his mother, “Behold, Esau my brother is a hairy man, and I am a smooth man.
controles.kjv: And Jacob said to Rebekah his mother, Behold, Esau my brother is a hairy man, and I am a smooth man:
controles.livre: E Jacó disse a Rebeca sua mãe: Eis que Esaú meu irmão é homem peludo, e eu liso:

versos.hebraico: אוּלַ֤י יְמֻשֵּׁ֨נִי֙ אָבִ֔י וְהָיִ֥יתִי בְעֵינָ֖יו כִּמְתַעְתֵּ֑עַ וְהֵבֵאתִ֥י עָלַ֛י קְלָלָ֖ה וְלֹ֥א בְרָכָֽה׃

controles.web: What if my father touches me? I will seem to him as a deceiver, and I would bring a curse on myself, and not a blessing.”
controles.kjv: My father peradventure will feel me, and I shall seem to him as a deceiver; and I shall bring a curse upon me, and not a blessing.
controles.livre: Talvez meu pai me apalpe, e me terá por enganador, e trarei sobre mim maldição e não bênção.

versos.hebraico: וַתֹּ֤אמֶר לוֹ֙ אִמּ֔וֹ עָלַ֥י קִלְלָתְךָ֖ בְּנִ֑י אַ֛ךְ שְׁמַ֥ע בְּקֹלִ֖י וְלֵ֥ךְ קַֽח־לִֽי׃

controles.web: His mother said to him, “Let your curse be on me, my son. Only obey my voice, and go get them for me.”
controles.kjv: And his mother said unto him, Upon me be thy curse, my son: only obey my voice, and go fetch me them.
controles.livre: E sua mãe respondeu: Filho meu, sobre mim tua maldição: somente obedece à minha voz, e vai e traze-os a mim.

versos.hebraico: וַיֵּ֨לֶךְ֙ וַיִּקַּ֔ח וַיָּבֵ֖א לְאִמּ֑וֹ וַתַּ֤עַשׂ אִמּוֹ֙ מַטְעַמִּ֔ים כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר אָהֵ֥ב אָבִֽיו׃

controles.web: He went, and got them, and brought them to his mother. His mother made savory food, such as his father loved.
controles.kjv: And he went, and fetched, and brought them to his mother: and his mother made savoury meat, such as his father loved.
controles.livre: Então ele foi, e tomou, e trouxe-os à sua mãe: e sua mãe fez guisados, como seu pai gostava.

versos.hebraico: וַתִּקַּ֣ח רִ֠בְקָה אֶת־בִּגְדֵ֨י עֵשָׂ֜ו בְּנָ֤הּ הַגָּדֹל֙ הַחֲמֻדֹ֔ת אֲשֶׁ֥ר אִתָּ֖הּ בַּבָּ֑יִת וַתַּלְבֵּ֥שׁ אֶֽת־יַעֲקֹ֖ב בְּנָ֥הּ הַקָּטָֽן׃

controles.web: Rebekah took the good clothes of Esau, her elder son, which were with her in the house, and put them on Jacob, her younger son.
controles.kjv: And Rebekah took goodly raiment of her eldest son Esau, which were with her in the house, and put them upon Jacob her younger son:
controles.livre: E tomou Rebeca as roupas de Esaú seu filho maior, as melhores, que ela tinha em casa, e vestiu a Jacó seu filho menor:

versos.hebraico: וְאֵ֗ת עֹרֹת֙ גְּדָיֵ֣י הָֽעִזִּ֔ים הִלְבִּ֖ישָׁה עַל־יָדָ֑יו וְעַ֖ל חֶלְקַ֥ת צַוָּארָֽיו׃

controles.web: She put the skins of the young goats on his hands, and on the smooth of his neck.
controles.kjv: And she put the skins of the kids of the goats upon his hands, and upon the smooth of his neck:
controles.livre: E fez-lhe vestir sobre suas mãos e sobre o pescoço onde não tinha pelo, as peles dos cabritos das cabras;

versos.hebraico: וַתִּתֵּ֧ן אֶת־הַמַּטְעַמִּ֛ים וְאֶת־הַלֶּ֖חֶם אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֑תָה בְּיַ֖ד יַעֲקֹ֥ב בְּנָֽהּ׃

controles.web: She gave the savory food and the bread, which she had prepared, into the hand of her son Jacob.
controles.kjv: And she gave the savoury meat and the bread, which she had prepared, into the hand of her son Jacob.
controles.livre: E entregou os guisados e o pão que havia preparado, em mão de Jacó seu filho.

versos.hebraico: וַיָּבֹ֥א אֶל־אָבִ֖יו וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אָבִ֑י וַיֹּ֣אמֶר הִנֶּ֔נִּי מִ֥י אַתָּ֖ה בְּנִֽי׃

controles.web: He came to his father, and said, “My father?”   He said, “Here I am. Who are you, my son?”
controles.kjv: And he came unto his father, and said, My father: and he said, Here am I; who art thou, my son?
controles.livre: E ele foi a seu pai, e disse: Meu pai: e ele respondeu: Eis-me aqui, quem és, filho meu?

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יַעֲקֹ֜ב אֶל־אָבִ֗יו אָנֹכִי֙ עֵשָׂ֣ו בְּכֹרֶ֔ךָ עָשִׂ֕יתִי כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבַּ֖רְתָּ אֵלָ֑י קֽוּם־נָ֣א שְׁבָ֗ה וְאָכְלָה֙ מִצֵּידִ֔י בַּעֲב֖וּר תְּבָרֲכַ֥נִּי נַפְשֶֽׁךָ׃

controles.web: Jacob said to his father, “I am Esau your firstborn. I have done what you asked me to do. Please arise, sit and eat of my venison, that your soul may bless me.”
controles.kjv: And Jacob said unto his father, I am Esau thy firstborn; I have done according as thou badest me: arise, I pray thee, sit and eat of my venison, that thy soul may bless me.
controles.livre: E Jacó disse a seu pai: Eu sou Esaú teu primogênito; fiz como me disseste: levanta-te agora, e senta, e come de minha caça, para que me abençoe tua alma.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יִצְחָק֙ אֶל־בְּנ֔וֹ מַה־זֶּ֛ה מִהַ֥רְתָּ לִמְצֹ֖א בְּנִ֑י וַיֹּ֕אמֶר כִּ֥י הִקְרָ֛ה יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ לְפָנָֽי׃

controles.web: Isaac said to his son, “How is it that you have found it so quickly, my son?”   He said, “Because Yahweh your God gave me success.”
controles.kjv: And Isaac said unto his son, How is it that thou hast found it so quickly, my son? And he said, Because the Lord thy God brought it to me.
controles.livre: Então Isaque disse a seu filho: Como é que a achaste tão depressa, filho meu? E ele respondeu: Porque o SENHOR teu Deus fez que se encontrasse diante de mim.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יִצְחָק֙ אֶֽל־יַעֲקֹ֔ב גְּשָׁה־נָּ֥א וַאֲמֻֽשְׁךָ֖ בְּנִ֑י הַֽאַתָּ֥ה זֶ֛ה בְּנִ֥י עֵשָׂ֖ו אִם־לֹֽא׃

controles.web: Isaac said to Jacob, “Please come near, that I may feel you, my son, whether you are really my son Esau or not.”
controles.kjv: And Isaac said unto Jacob, Come near, I pray thee, that I may feel thee, my son, whether thou be my very son Esau or not.
controles.livre: E Isaque disse a Jacó: Aproxima-te agora, e te apalparei, filho meu, para que eu saiba se és meu filho Esaú ou não.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּגַּ֧שׁ יַעֲקֹ֛ב אֶל־יִצְחָ֥ק אָבִ֖יו וַיְמֻשֵּׁ֑הוּ וַיֹּ֗אמֶר הַקֹּל֙ ק֣וֹל יַעֲקֹ֔ב וְהַיָּדַ֖יִם יְדֵ֥י עֵשָֽׂו׃

controles.web: Jacob went near to Isaac his father. He felt him, and said, “The voice is Jacob’s voice, but the hands are the hands of Esau.”
controles.kjv: And Jacob went near unto Isaac his father; and he felt him, and said, The voice is Jacob’s voice, but the hands are the hands of Esau.
controles.livre: E chegou-se Jacó a seu pai Isaque; e ele lhe apalpou, e disse: A voz é a voz de Jacó, mas as mãos, as mãos de Esaú.

versos.hebraico: וְלֹ֣א הִכִּיר֔וֹ כִּֽי־הָי֣וּ יָדָ֗יו כִּידֵ֛י עֵשָׂ֥ו אָחִ֖יו שְׂעִרֹ֑ת וַֽיְבָרְכֵֽהוּ׃

controles.web: He didn’t recognize him, because his hands were hairy, like his brother, Esau’s hands. So he blessed him.
controles.kjv: And he discerned him not, because his hands were hairy, as his brother Esau’s hands: so he blessed him.
controles.livre: E não lhe reconheceu, porque suas mãos eram peludas como as mãos de Esaú: e lhe abençoou.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֕אמֶר אַתָּ֥ה זֶ֖ה בְּנִ֣י עֵשָׂ֑ו וַיֹּ֖אמֶר אָֽנִי׃

controles.web: He said, “Are you really my son Esau?”   He said, “I am.”
controles.kjv: And he said, Art thou my very son Esau? And he said, I am.
controles.livre: E disse: És tu meu filho Esaú? E ele respondeu: Eu sou.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר הַגִּ֤שָׁה לִּי֙ וְאֹֽכְלָה֙ מִצֵּ֣יד בְּנִ֔י לְמַ֥עַן תְּבָֽרֶכְךָ֖ נַפְשִׁ֑י וַיַּגֶּשׁ־לוֹ֙ וַיֹּאכַ֔ל וַיָּ֧בֵא ל֦וֹ יַ֖יִן וַיֵּֽשְׁתְּ׃

controles.web: He said, “Bring it near to me, and I will eat of my son’s venison, that my soul may bless you.”   He brought it near to him, and he ate. He brought him wine, and he drank.
controles.kjv: And he said, Bring it near to me, and I will eat of my son’s venison, that my soul may bless thee. And he brought it near to him, and he did eat: and he brought him wine, and he drank.
controles.livre: E disse: Aproxima-a a mim, e comerei da caça de meu filho, para que te abençoe minha alma; e ele a aproximou, e comeu: trouxe-lhe também vinho, e bebeu.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר אֵלָ֖יו יִצְחָ֣ק אָבִ֑יו גְּשָׁה־נָּ֥א וּשְׁקָה־לִּ֖י בְּנִֽי׃

controles.web: His father Isaac said to him, “Come near now, and kiss me, my son.”
controles.kjv: And his father Isaac said unto him, Come near now, and kiss me, my son.
controles.livre: E disse-lhe Isaque seu pai: Aproxima-te agora, e beija-me, filho meu.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּגַּשׁ֙ וַיִּשַּׁק־ל֔וֹ וַיָּ֛רַח אֶת־רֵ֥יחַ בְּגָדָ֖יו וַֽיְבָרֲכֵ֑הוּ וַיֹּ֗אמֶר רְאֵה֙ רֵ֣יחַ בְּנִ֔י כְּרֵ֣יחַ שָׂדֶ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר בֵּרֲכ֖וֹ יְהוָֽה׃

controles.web: He came near, and kissed him. He smelled the smell of his clothing, and blessed him, and said,  “Behold, the smell of my son is as the smell of a field which Yahweh has blessed.
controles.kjv: And he came near, and kissed him: and he smelled the smell of his raiment, and blessed him, and said, See, the smell of my son is as the smell of a field which the Lord hath blessed:
controles.livre: E ele se chegou, e lhe beijou; e cheirou Isaque o cheiro de suas roupas, e lhe abençoou, e disse: Eis que o cheiro de meu filho é como o cheiro do campo que o SENHOR abençoou;

versos.hebraico: וְיִֽתֶּן־לְךָ֙ הָאֱלֹהִ֔ים מִטַּל֙ הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם וּמִשְׁמַנֵּ֖י הָאָ֑רֶץ וְרֹ֥ב דָּגָ֖ן וְתִירֹֽשׁ׃

controles.web: God give you of the dew of the sky, of the fatness of the earth, and plenty of grain and new wine.
controles.kjv: Therefore God give thee of the dew of heaven, and the fatness of the earth, and plenty of corn and wine:
controles.livre: Deus, pois, te dê do orvalho do céu, e das gorduras da terra, e abundância de trigo e de mosto.

versos.hebraico: יַֽעַבְד֣וּךָ עַמִּ֗ים וישתחו לְךָ֙ לְאֻמִּ֔ים הֱוֵ֤ה גְבִיר֙ לְאַחֶ֔יךָ וְיִשְׁתַּחֲוּ֥וּ לְךָ֖ בְּנֵ֣י אִמֶּ֑ךָ אֹרְרֶ֣יךָ אָר֔וּר וּֽמְבָרֲכֶ֖יךָ בָּרֽוּךְ׃

controles.web: Let peoples serve you, and nations bow down to you. Be lord over your brothers. Let your mother’s sons bow down to you. Cursed be everyone who curses you. Blessed be everyone who blesses you.”
controles.kjv: Let people serve thee, and nations bow down to thee: be lord over thy brethren, and let thy mother’s sons bow down to thee: cursed be every one that curseth thee, and blessed be he that blesseth thee.
controles.livre: Sirvam-te povos, E nações se inclinem a ti: Sê senhor de teus irmãos, e inclinem-se a ti os filhos de tua mãe; malditos os que te amaldiçoarem, e benditos os que te abençoarem.

versos.hebraico: וַיְהִ֗י כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר כִּלָּ֣ה יִצְחָק֮ לְבָרֵ֣ךְ אֶֽת־יַעֲקֹב֒ וַיְהִ֗י אַ֣ךְ יָצֹ֤א יָצָא֙ יַעֲקֹ֔ב מֵאֵ֥ת פְּנֵ֖י יִצְחָ֣ק אָבִ֑יו וְעֵשָׂ֣ו אָחִ֔יו בָּ֖א מִצֵּידֽוֹ׃

controles.web: As soon as Isaac had made an end of blessing Jacob, and Jacob had just gone out from the presence of Isaac his father, Esau his brother came in from his hunting.
controles.kjv: And it came to pass, as soon as Isaac had made an end of blessing Jacob, and Jacob was yet scarce gone out from the presence of Isaac his father, that Esau his brother came in from his hunting.
controles.livre: E aconteceu, logo que havia Isaque de abençoar a Jacó, e apenas havia saído Jacó de diante de Isaque seu pai, que Esaú seu irmão veio de sua caça.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּ֤עַשׂ גַּם־הוּא֙ מַטְעַמִּ֔ים וַיָּבֵ֖א לְאָבִ֑יו וַיֹּ֣אמֶר לְאָבִ֗יו יָקֻ֤ם אָבִי֙ וְיֹאכַל֙ מִצֵּ֣יד בְּנ֔וֹ בַּעֲב֖וּר תְּבָרֲכַ֥נִּי נַפְשֶֽׁךָ׃

controles.web: He also made savory food, and brought it to his father. He said to his father, “Let my father arise, and eat of his son’s venison, that your soul may bless me.”
controles.kjv: And he also had made savoury meat, and brought it unto his father, and said unto his father, Let my father arise, and eat of his son’s venison, that thy soul may bless me.
controles.livre: E também ele fez guisado, e trouxe a seu pai, e disse-lhe: Levante-se meu pai, e coma da caça de seu filho, para que me abençoe tua alma.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר ל֛וֹ יִצְחָ֥ק אָבִ֖יו מִי־אָ֑תָּה וַיֹּ֕אמֶר אֲנִ֛י בִּנְךָ֥ בְכֹֽרְךָ֖ עֵשָֽׂו׃

controles.web: Isaac his father said to him, “Who are you?”   He said, “I am your son, your firstborn, Esau.”
controles.kjv: And Isaac his father said unto him, Who art thou? And he said, I am thy son, thy firstborn Esau.
controles.livre: Então Isaque seu pai lhe disse: Quem és tu? E ele disse: Eu sou teu filho, teu primogênito, Esaú.

versos.hebraico: וַיֶּחֱרַ֨ד יִצְחָ֣ק חֲרָדָה֮ גְּדֹלָ֣ה עַד־מְאֹד֒ וַיֹּ֡אמֶר מִֽי־אֵפ֡וֹא ה֣וּא הַצָּֽד־צַיִד֩ וַיָּ֨בֵא לִ֜י וָאֹכַ֥ל מִכֹּ֛ל בְּטֶ֥רֶם תָּב֖וֹא וָאֲבָרֲכֵ֑הוּ גַּם־בָּר֖וּךְ יִהְיֶֽה׃

controles.web: Isaac trembled violently, and said, “Who, then, is he who has taken venison, and brought it me, and I have eaten of all before you came, and have blessed him? Yes, he will be blessed.”
controles.kjv: And Isaac trembled very exceedingly, and said, Who? where is he that hath taken venison, and brought it me, and I have eaten of all before thou camest, and have blessed him? yea, and he shall be blessed.
controles.livre: E Estremeceu-se Isaque com grande estremecimento, e disse: Quem é o que veio aqui, que agarrou caça, e me trouxe, e comi de tudo antes que viesses? Eu o abençoei, e será bendito.

versos.hebraico: כִּשְׁמֹ֤עַ עֵשָׂו֙ אֶת־דִּבְרֵ֣י אָבִ֔יו וַיִּצְעַ֣ק צְעָקָ֔ה גְּדֹלָ֥ה וּמָרָ֖ה עַד־מְאֹ֑ד וַיֹּ֣אמֶר לְאָבִ֔יו בָּרֲכֵ֥נִי גַם־אָ֖נִי אָבִֽי׃

controles.web: When Esau heard the words of his father, he cried with an exceeding great and bitter cry, and said to his father, “Bless me, even me also, my father.”
controles.kjv: And when Esau heard the words of his father, he cried with a great and exceeding bitter cry, and said unto his father, Bless me, even me also, O my father.
controles.livre: Quando Esaú ouviu as palavras de seu pai clamou com uma muito grande e muito amarga exclamação, e lhe disse: Abençoa também a mim, meu pai.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֕אמֶר בָּ֥א אָחִ֖יךָ בְּמִרְמָ֑ה וַיִּקַּ֖ח בִּרְכָתֶֽךָ׃

controles.web: He said, “Your brother came with deceit, and has taken away your blessing.”
controles.kjv: And he said, Thy brother came with subtilty, and hath taken away thy blessing.
controles.livre: E ele disse: Veio teu irmão com engano, e tomou tua bênção.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֡אמֶר הֲכִי֩ קָרָ֨א שְׁמ֜וֹ יַעֲקֹ֗ב וַֽיַּעְקְבֵ֨נִי֙ זֶ֣ה פַעֲמַ֔יִם אֶת־בְּכֹרָתִ֣י לָקָ֔ח וְהִנֵּ֥ה עַתָּ֖ה לָקַ֣ח בִּרְכָתִ֑י וַיֹּאמַ֕ר הֲלֹא־אָצַ֥לְתָּ לִּ֖י בְּרָכָֽה׃

controles.web: He said, “Isn’t he rightly named Jacob? For he has supplanted me these two times. He took away my birthright. See, now he has taken away my blessing.” He said, “Haven’t you reserved a blessing for me?”
controles.kjv: And he said, Is not he rightly named Jacob? for he hath supplanted me these two times: he took away my birthright; and, behold, now he hath taken away my blessing. And he said, Hast thou not reserved a blessing for me?
controles.livre: E ele respondeu: Bem chamaram seu nome Jacó, que já me enganou duas vezes; tirou minha primogenitura, e eis que agora tomou minha bênção. E disse: Não guardaste bênção para mim?

versos.hebraico: וַיַּ֨עַן יִצְחָ֜ק וַיֹּ֣אמֶר לְעֵשָׂ֗ו הֵ֣ן גְּבִ֞יר שַׂמְתִּ֥יו לָךְ֙ וְאֶת־כָּל־אֶחָ֗יו נָתַ֤תִּי לוֹ֙ לַעֲבָדִ֔ים וְדָגָ֥ן וְתִירֹ֖שׁ סְמַכְתִּ֑יו וּלְכָ֣ה אֵפ֔וֹא מָ֥ה אֶֽעֱשֶׂ֖ה בְּנִֽי׃

controles.web: Isaac answered Esau, “Behold, I have made him your lord, and all his brothers have I given to him for servants. With grain and new wine have I sustained him. What then will I do for you, my son?”
controles.kjv: And Isaac answered and said unto Esau, Behold, I have made him thy lord, and all his brethren have I given to him for servants; and with corn and wine have I sustained him: and what shall I do now unto thee, my son?
controles.livre: Isaque respondeu e disse a Esaú: Eis que eu o pus por senhor teu, e lhe dei por servos a todos os seus irmãos: de trigo e de vinho lhe provi: que, pois, farei a ti agora, filho meu?

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר עֵשָׂ֜ו אֶל־אָבִ֗יו הַֽבְרָכָ֨ה אַחַ֤ת הִֽוא־לְךָ֙ אָבִ֔י בָּרֲכֵ֥נִי גַם־אָ֖נִי אָבִ֑י וַיִּשָּׂ֥א עֵשָׂ֛ו קֹל֖וֹ וַיֵּֽבְךְּ׃

controles.web: Esau said to his father, “Have you but one blessing, my father? Bless me, even me also, my father.” Esau lifted up his voice, and wept.
controles.kjv: And Esau said unto his father, Hast thou but one blessing, my father? bless me, even me also, O my father. And Esau lifted up his voice, and wept.
controles.livre: E Esaú respondeu a seu pai: Não tens mais que uma só bênção, meu pai? Abençoa também a mim, meu pai. E levantou Esaú sua voz, e chorou.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּ֛עַן יִצְחָ֥ק אָבִ֖יו וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלָ֑יו הִנֵּ֞ה מִשְׁמַנֵּ֤י הָאָ֨רֶץ֙ יִהְיֶ֣ה מֽוֹשָׁבֶ֔ךָ וּמִטַּ֥ל הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם מֵעָֽל׃

controles.web: Isaac his father answered him,  “Behold, of the fatness of the earth will be your dwelling, and of the dew of the sky from above.
controles.kjv: And Isaac his father answered and said unto him, Behold, thy dwelling shall be the fatness of the earth, and of the dew of heaven from above;
controles.livre: Então Isaque seu pai falou e disse-lhe: Eis que será tua habitação sem gorduras da terra, E sem orvalho dos céus de acima;

versos.hebraico: וְעַל־חַרְבְּךָ֣ תִֽחְיֶ֔ה וְאֶת־אָחִ֖יךָ תַּעֲבֹ֑ד וְהָיָה֙ כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר תָּרִ֔יד וּפָרַקְתָּ֥ עֻלּ֖וֹ מֵעַ֥ל צַוָּארֶֽךָ׃

controles.web: By your sword will you live, and you will serve your brother. It will happen, when you will break loose, that you shall shake his yoke from off your neck.”
controles.kjv: And by thy sword shalt thou live, and shalt serve thy brother; and it shall come to pass when thou shalt have the dominion, that thou shalt break his yoke from off thy neck.
controles.livre: E por tua espada viverás, e a teu irmão servirás: E sucederá quando te dominares, Que descarregarás seu jugo de teu pescoço.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּשְׂטֹ֤ם עֵשָׂו֙ אֶֽת־יַעֲקֹ֔ב עַל־הַ֨בְּרָכָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר בֵּרֲכ֖וֹ אָבִ֑יו וַיֹּ֨אמֶר עֵשָׂ֜ו בְּלִבּ֗וֹ יִקְרְבוּ֙ יְמֵי֙ אֵ֣בֶל אָבִ֔י וְאַֽהַרְגָ֖ה אֶת־יַעֲקֹ֥ב אָחִֽי׃

controles.web: Esau hated Jacob because of the blessing with which his father blessed him. Esau said in his heart, “The days of mourning for my father are at hand. Then I will kill my brother Jacob.”
controles.kjv: And Esau hated Jacob because of the blessing wherewith his father blessed him: and Esau said in his heart, The days of mourning for my father are at hand; then will I slay my brother Jacob.
controles.livre: E odiou Esaú a Jacó pela bênção com que lhe havia abençoado, e disse em seu coração: Chegarão os dias do luto de meu pai, e eu matarei a Jacó meu irmão.

versos.hebraico: וַיֻּגַּ֣ד לְרִבְקָ֔ה אֶת־דִּבְרֵ֥י עֵשָׂ֖ו בְּנָ֣הּ הַגָּדֹ֑ל וַתִּשְׁלַ֞ח וַתִּקְרָ֤א לְיַעֲקֹב֙ בְּנָ֣הּ הַקָּטָ֔ן וַתֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלָ֔יו הִנֵּה֙ עֵשָׂ֣ו אָחִ֔יךָ מִתְנַחֵ֥ם לְךָ֖ לְהָרְגֶֽךָ׃

controles.web: The words of Esau, her elder son, were told to Rebekah. She sent and called Jacob, her younger son, and said to him, “Behold, your brother Esau comforts himself about you by planning to kill you.
controles.kjv: And these words of Esau her elder son were told to Rebekah: and she sent and called Jacob her younger son, and said unto him, Behold, thy brother Esau, as touching thee, doth comfort himself, purposing to kill thee.
controles.livre: E foram ditas a Rebeca as palavras de Esaú seu filho mais velho: e ela enviou e chamou a Jacó seu filho mais novo, e disse-lhe: Eis que, Esaú teu irmão se consola acerca de ti com a ideia de matar-te.

versos.hebraico: וְעַתָּ֥ה בְנִ֖י שְׁמַ֣ע בְּקֹלִ֑י וְק֧וּם בְּרַח־לְךָ֛ אֶל־לָבָ֥ן אָחִ֖י חָרָֽנָה׃

controles.web: Now therefore, my son, obey my voice. Arise, flee to Laban, my brother, in Haran.
controles.kjv: Now therefore, my son, obey my voice; and arise, flee thou to Laban my brother to Haran;
controles.livre: Agora, pois, filho meu, obedece à minha voz; levanta-te, e foge-te a Labão meu irmão, a Harã.

versos.hebraico: וְיָשַׁבְתָּ֥ עִמּ֖וֹ יָמִ֣ים אֲחָדִ֑ים עַ֥ד אֲשֶׁר־תָּשׁ֖וּב חֲמַ֥ת אָחִֽיךָ׃

controles.web: Stay with him a few days, until your brother’s fury turns away;
controles.kjv: And tarry with him a few days, until thy brother’s fury turn away;
controles.livre: E mora com ele alguns dias, até que a ira de teu irmão se diminua;

versos.hebraico: עַד־שׁ֨וּב אַף־אָחִ֜יךָ מִמְּךָ֗ וְשָׁכַח֙ אֵ֣ת אֲשֶׁר־עָשִׂ֣יתָ לּ֔וֹ וְשָׁלַחְתִּ֖י וּלְקַחְתִּ֣יךָ מִשָּׁ֑ם לָמָ֥ה אֶשְׁכַּ֛ל גַּם־שְׁנֵיכֶ֖ם י֥וֹם אֶחָֽד׃

controles.web: until your brother’s anger turn away from you, and he forgets what you have done to him. Then I will send, and get you from there. Why should I be bereaved of you both in one day?”
controles.kjv: Until thy brother’s anger turn away from thee, and he forget that which thou hast done to him: then I will send, and fetch thee from thence: why should I be deprived also of you both in one day?
controles.livre: Até que se aplaque a ira de teu irmão contra ti, e se esqueça do que lhe fizeste: eu enviarei então, e te trarei dali: por que serei privada de vós ambos em um dia?

versos.hebraico: וַתֹּ֤אמֶר רִבְקָה֙ אֶל־יִצְחָ֔ק קַ֣צְתִּי בְחַיַּ֔י מִפְּנֵ֖י בְּנ֣וֹת חֵ֑ת אִם־לֹקֵ֣חַ יַ֠עֲקֹב אִשָּׁ֨ה מִבְּנֽוֹת־חֵ֤ת כָּאֵ֨לֶּה֙ מִבְּנ֣וֹת הָאָ֔רֶץ לָ֥מָּה לִּ֖י חַיִּֽים׃

controles.web: Rebekah said to Isaac, “I am weary of my life because of the daughters of Heth. If Jacob takes a wife of the daughters of Heth, such as these, of the daughters of the land, what good will my life do me?”
controles.kjv: And Rebekah said to Isaac, I am weary of my life because of the daughters of Heth: if Jacob take a wife of the daughters of Heth, such as these which are of the daughters of the land, what good shall my life do me?
controles.livre: E disse Rebeca a Isaque: Desgosto tenho de minha vida, por causa das filhas de Hete. Se Jacó toma mulher das filhas de Hete, como estas, das filhas desta terra, para que quero a vida?
